name: Wildlife
description:
Plants and animals people have photographed in Stratford and shared on iNaturalist since November 2016. Only sightings other iNaturalist users have confirmed are shown, and only where the photographer allows reuse. Locations of at-risk species are hidden by iNaturalist, so they are left out.

Click a dot to see the photo, who took it, and the sighting on iNaturalist.
